entries.title: Judges 19:1
segments: When there is no regular, efficient civil government, such is human nature, that crimes of all descriptions will abound and the wicked triumph.

entries.title: Judges 19:6
segments: Hospitality and kindness to friends are highly commendable, but we should not urge them against their convenience and to the neglect of their duties.

entries.title: Judges 19:7
segments: We should never let kindness and importunity overcome our judgment.  If we do, by the evils which spring from it we may, when too late, be taught our folly.  Multitudes have suffered for want of the habit of saying to all undue solicitations, promptly, firmly, perseveringly, No.

entries.title: Judges 19:8
segments: Nothing should be delayed till afternoon that ought to be done in the morning.

entries.title: Judges 19:12
segments:
A stranger; the city was then inhabited to a considerable extent by Jebusites, one of the nations of Canaan that had not been driven out. 
 
  Gibeah; this was a few miles north of Jerusalem, and on the way towards mount Ephraim. 
 
It is a great comfort and blessing to travellers to find good lodging places, where they can rest in quietness, and not be disturbed by the wicked.

entries.title: Judges 19:15
segments: To lodge; there were then no taverns, and travellers were dependent for lodging on private hospitality.

entries.title: Judges 19:16
segments: Diligence in business is conducive to excellence of character, and promotive of all those virtues which secure the welfare and comfort of both citizens and strangers.

entries.title: Judges 19:18
segments: The house of the Lord; this was in Shiloh, and probably not far from the place where the Levite dwelt.

entries.title: Judges 19:19
segments: No want; except for lodging.  He mentioned his provisions to show that he should not be burdensome to his entertainer.

entries.title: Judges 19:20
segments:
Peace be with thee; the usual salutation of kindness. 
 
Hospitality, especially to the needy, is a great blessing to the giver and to the receiver.  It is well-pleasing to God, and when exercised from love to him will receive a gracious and an abundant reward.

entries.title: Judges 19:22
segments:
Sons of Belial; wicked, abandoned men. 
 
The greater the light which men resist, the more wicked they will be; and apostate professors of religion, who become openly vicious, are among the worst of mankind.

entries.title: Judges 19:25
segments: Habitual wickedness makes men inexpressibly cruel, and none are so dead to pity and compassion as those who are given up to its power.  It is the spirit of hell, and those who pursue it are ripening for that place of torment.
